description: Search global news by keyword across Currents (70k+ sources). Filter by language, category, country, and date range. Example: search_news({ keywords: "artificial intelligence", language: "en", limit: 15 })

_apiKey.description: Optional Currents API key. Omit to use the platform key.

category.description: Optional category filter, e.g. "technology", "business". Use list_categories to see options.

end_date.description: Optional ISO 8601 end of date range, e.g. "2026-02-01T00:00:00".

limit.description: Max number of articles to return (default 15).

start_date.description: Optional ISO 8601 start of date range, e.g. "2026-01-01T00:00:00".

name: search_news
title: Search News
